headline: Current best public blend: notebook-faithful ConvNeXt full14 mixed with a top-3 manual+teacher075 SegFormer recipe.
summary: After replacing the early reverse-engineered ConvNeXt exporter with a notebook-faithful inference path and retuning the blend on a labeled holdout, `submission_blend_cnxt35_seg65_top3_mt075_full14_thr40.csv` became the current public leader.

comparative_public_submissions.note: Best pure SegFormer ensemble among the tested supervised_v4 variants.
Legacy blend path before the notebook-faithful ConvNeXt cleanup.
Legacy standalone ConvNeXt artifact produced through the broken exporter path.

commands.smoke: PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/run_convnext_ensemble.py --mode blend_segformer --cnxt-tta-mode full14 --segformer-recipe top3_manual_teacher075 --segformer-weight 0.65 --threshold 0.40 --limit 5
commands.full_inference: PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/run_convnext_ensemble.py --mode blend_segformer --cnxt-tta-mode full14 --segformer-recipe top3_manual_teacher075 --segformer-weight 0.65 --threshold 0.40

validation_checks: The current best blend submission was generated for all 2000 test images.
The best blend weights came from a full holdout search on 594 labeled validation images.
Submission format was validated after fixing the early ConvNeXt exporter bugs.
warnings: ConvNeXt checkpoints are external notebook-trained artifacts; the strongest practical evidence is the public leaderboard score plus the local holdout search, not a clean in-repo CV benchmark.
Do not compare the old standalone ConvNeXt uploads directly to the notebook-faithful blend path; the early exporter produced malformed or semantically broken submissions.
